semantic.name: surface
semantic.why: Page background. The default canvas everything sits on.

semantic.name: surface-raised
semantic.why: Cards, panels, popovers. Lighter than the page in BOTH themes — the paper-on-canvas model from the Figma screens.

semantic.name: surface-sunken
semantic.why: Wells, track backgrounds, inset media. One level below the page.

semantic.name: surface-overlay
semantic.why: Sheets, modals, menus. Same value as -raised; separated by elevation and scrim, not hue.

semantic.name: surface-inverse
semantic.why: Tooltips, high-emphasis chips — deliberately opposite the theme.

semantic.name: on-surface
semantic.why: Default body and heading text on any surface token.

semantic.name: on-surface-muted
semantic.why: Secondary text, metadata, placeholder. Still a full 4.5:1 — never dips below the body threshold.

semantic.name: on-surface-disabled
semantic.why: Text and icons in a disabled control. Exempt from 1.4.3; held near 3:1 anyway.

semantic.name: on-surface-inverse
semantic.why: Text on --surface-inverse.

semantic.name: border-subtle
semantic.why: Dividers and decorative outlines ONLY. Never permitted on an interactive boundary.

semantic.name: border-strong
semantic.why: The only neutral border allowed to carry a control boundary — solved to ≥3:1 (1.4.11).

semantic.name: border-focus
semantic.why: Focus indicator colour. ≥3:1 against every surface token in both themes.

semantic.name: interactive-primary
semantic.why: Terracotta solid fill — the family's resting state.

semantic.name: interactive-primary-hover
semantic.why: Terracotta solid fill on hover.

semantic.name: interactive-primary-active
semantic.why: Terracotta solid fill while pressed. Solved so the SAME -on foreground still holds 4.5:1 — a plain step-11 swap would have put dark text on a dark fill.

semantic.name: interactive-primary-disabled
semantic.why: Disabled fill — neutral, so no family reads as available.

semantic.name: interactive-primary-on
semantic.why: Foreground on the terracotta solid. Theme-conditional: dark mode brightens the solid, so the foreground flips. This is the clearest case of dark mode not being an inversion.

semantic.name: interactive-primary-on-disabled
semantic.why: Foreground on a disabled fill. Exempt from 1.4.3 — pair with a non-colour cue.

semantic.name: interactive-primary-subtle
semantic.why: Terracotta tinted fill — chips, tags, selected rows.

semantic.name: interactive-primary-subtle-hover
semantic.why: Terracotta tinted fill on hover.

semantic.name: interactive-primary-subtle-active
semantic.why: Terracotta tinted fill while pressed.

semantic.name: interactive-primary-on-subtle
semantic.why: Text and icons on the terracotta tinted fill, at any of its three states.

semantic.name: interactive-primary-border
semantic.why: Terracotta boundary at ≥3:1. MANDATORY on any terracotta fill that is not itself 3:1 against the surface.
